title: Cowboys fan runs over TV with truck in crazy meltdown after embarrassing loss to Buccaneers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys fan runs over TV with truck in crazy meltdown after embarrassing loss to Buccaneers
sources.description: Furious Cowboys fan wearing a Dak Prescott jersey smashes his TV and runs it over with his truck after Dallas' humiliating 24-16 loss to the Buccaneers.
